title: Customer Support Knowledge Base
content: Use verified operator records when answering account-specific questions. A failed payment does not confirm a refund. An unresolved account or payment issue must be referred to support. Do not promise actions that have not been confirmed.

title: Legacy Welcome Bonus FAQ
content: Historical guidance: the welcome bonus required a minimum qualifying deposit of EUR 20. This document is no longer approved for current eligibility decisions.

title: Current Welcome Bonus FAQ
content: Promotion NSG-B001 requires a minimum qualifying deposit of EUR 30. A completed deposit alone does not confirm that a bonus has been awarded. Eligibility and award status must be checked against the relevant approved promotion terms and verified player-promotion record.

title: Autumn Special Working Draft

title: Responsible Gambling Support Guidance
content: Treat self-exclusion and gambling-harm requests seriously. A recorded request is not proof that an account restriction has already been activated. Do not encourage further gambling or offer promotional incentives in these cases. Refer unconfirmed account changes to the responsible gambling support process.

title: Verification Support FAQ
content: If an identity document is rejected and the authorised record contains no rejection reason, do not invent one. Explain the available resubmission guidance and refer the customer to support for the exact reason or further assistance.
